result.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, blacklist entries are lowercased (`.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`) but guests are compared via `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` without lowercasing `guest`, so mixed-case guest emails bypass the blacklist entirely. Mechanism is verifiable directly in the diff.

judged_text: Blacklisted guest emails are lowercased when the list is built but the submitted guest is compared unmodified, so the blacklist constraint fails for any mixed-case input. BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS=spam@x.com does not block 'Spam@X.com': the filter (!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)) passes, the attendee row is created, calendar invite and emails are sent — the intended blacklist guard silently does not apply to any email whose case differs from the env entry.
